label: FP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is a False Positive. User input 'param' is used to construct a system property name ('app.feature.' + param) passed to System.getProperty. This input does not reach the HTML response writer. The response outputs the value of the property ('flag'), not the property name or the original user input. Since the tainted data does not reach the browser-rendered context, no XSS vulnerability exists.

evidence.note: User input 'param' flows into System.getProperty as a name argument, not into the response writer. Response prints 'flag' (property value), avoiding reflection of 'param'.
